modules.module_title: Organize lab to carry out testing of samples

pcs.pc_description: maintain the cleanliness of the work area using approved sanitizers and keep it free from dust, pests, and flies.
Clean the testing equipment with an approved cleaning agent following SOP guidelines.
verify the working and performance of all sampling devices and other equipment used in the lab as per the standard operating procedure
maintain and test the sterility of equipment
maintain glassware by cleaning, washing, sterilizing, and distributing.
check the equipment is calibrated as per the testing requirement.
monitor the temperatures of freezers and refrigerators.
clean N-Evap, water bath, refrigerators, and foreheads.
adhere to procedures for sample return, disposal, and archiving.
keep laboratory supplies ready by inventorying stock, placing orders, and verifying receipts
adhere to safety guidelines at all times within the laboratory.
keeps equipment operating by following operating instructions; troubleshooting breakdowns; maintaining supplies; performing preventive maintenance; calling for repairs.
attend to minor repairs/ faults of machineries, if required.
verify the adequacy and condition of the sample received, it should conform to the standards set by the lab.
• examine the sample and identity of the product • identity: plant-based food, animal-based food, state of maturity, use before date, etc.
check the sample received is sealed tightly and that there is no leakage
verify the sample containers for gross physical defects
Verify the product label has important details related to the sample
Verify the preservative details are present with their quantity

• Verify that the sample has all the collection details • details: sample number, collecting official’s name and date, sampling point(address), batch number, transport conditions (mode and condition of transport), date of submission to the lab, etc.
maintain all quality parameters as per QC norms
verify the chain of custody of the sample(s) and maintain the required storage parameters for the sample.
document the product’s condition at the time of receiving as per the format maintained by the organization

modules.module_title: Carry out visual inspection of received samples

pcs.pc_description: • Verify the physical conditions of the product received for testing • Physical condition: solid, liquid, semi-solid, frozen
• Verify the product is free from any contaminants • Contaminants: fungus, pests, etc
raise concerns about the samples to the supervisor
deliver samples to the laboratory for testing with the original condition of the samples

modules.module_title: Carry out sample preparation for testing

pcs.pc_description: verify that the sample should be representative of whole lot of food
prepare at least five samples for testing
Use clean, dry, leak-proof, widemouthed, sterile, suitable-sized containers for samples of the product
reduce the sample to analytical portions using riffling and quartering methods (bulk solid sample)
carry out homogenization of liquid sample for consistency
maintain purity of the sample for testing
measure portion size, weight, volume, density of the sample to be tested
comply with FSSAI and BIS rules and regulations for food sample preparation
document details of the sample prepared
take instructions from the lab In-charge and transfer the sample to the labs for testing
carefully store the samples whose testing is deferred
• check the label on the sample for details before storing them safely • (details to be verified: sample name, batch number (if applicable), date of preparation or collection, and storage conditions)
ensure the sample container or pouch is properly sealed and there is no leakage of material
store the samples on the priority basis (most urgent, urgent, or normal priority)
maintain the sample directory with details of the samples kept under storage
preserve the sample as per their prescribed light and temperature conditions to prevent spoilage
dispose the waste as per the organization's procedure
